image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a printed restaurant menu page. The menu features a large central photograph of a dish (appearing to be fried tofu or fish cakes with vegetables) inside a circular frame. Above the image is the restaurant name in stylized red and green characters/graphics, followed by smaller text. Below the image are lines of text describing items and prices, though they appear blurry and illegible. The menu is encased in a clear plastic sleeve or binder, visible on the left edge.

artifact_observations.location: Top header logo and bottom text blocks
artifact_observations.reasoning: The header contains pseudo-Chinese characters that do not form real words. The body text is completely illegible, blurred, and structurally nonsensical, failing to render readable language. This is a critical failure for a document-based class.
The food items have a slightly waxy, overly smooth texture typical of AI generation. The edges of the food items blend slightly into the white background of the plate/bowl.
The plastic sleeve on the left has some unnatural warping and reflection patterns that don't perfectly align with the flat plane of the menu paper.
